units.rawText: We hone our blades in the dark, we maintain order in the face of chaos, we hold up a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak. For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will...

units.rawText: These are the teachings we Sanctifiers have always obeyed. They represent our faith, our everything... Professor, could you tell me what the first human who wanted to prove God didn't exist must have felt in his heart?

units.rawText: Did he think that he had been abandoned by God, or that the thing called "God"... never even existed in the first place?
